name: Adolf Munkel trail, Val di Funes
why: A forest path that runs right at the foot of the Odle north walls, with a hut meal under the spires half way.
book: Nothing to book. Drive or take bus 340 from St. Magdalena to the Zannes car park (paid, fills by 9:30 in August). Huts open June to October.
water: Huts at Zannes, Gschnagenhardt Alm and Geisleralm; no reliable springs on the trail itself.
dangers: Short scree crossings under the walls: keep off them after heavy rain or in early-season snow.
Afternoon thunderstorms in July and August.
turnaround: Leave Geisleralm by 15:00 so you are back at Zannes before the evening storms.

points.name: Malga Zannes (Zanser Alm)
points.note: Car park and hut at 1,680 m at the head of the valley. Cross the stream and follow sign 6, then 35 into the forest.

points.name: Adolf Munkel path under the Odle
points.note: The path runs along the foot of the north walls of Sass Rigais and Furchetta, through stone pines and over short scree tongues.

points.name: Malga Geisler (Geisleralm)
points.note: Hut on open pasture at 1,996 m, the Odle spires straight above. Back to Zannes past Glatschalm.
